title: Japanese Lasagna
description: A fusion of Japanese and Italian flavors, this unique lasagna combines the savory elements of Japanese cuisine with the richness of cheese.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat. Add the sliced Portuguese sausage and cook until browned.
Add the Japanese curry powder to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the chopped green onions to the pan and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, combine the soy cheese and shredded mozzarella cheese.
Assemble the lasagna by spreading a layer of the curry powder mixture at the bottom of a baking dish.
Arrange a layer of lasagna noodles on top of the curry powder mixture.
Spread a layer of the cheese mixture on top of the noodles.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the lasagna in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the lasagna from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
